runtime.execution: Flask/gevent-patched service with per-input Python threads; synchronous prompted stages and provider executor; Playwright browser
runtime.service_boundary: Owns local project files, SQLite chat/state and browsers/processes; consumes provider/search/deployment APIs. No fabric contract.

summary: Fixed planner/researcher/coder and classified follow-up application pipeline; named agents are same-model stages, not concurrent colleagues.

inspection.scope: Entry/thread routing, initial/follow-up stages, model transport, file parser/save, command/repair, SQLite and config, browser integration and available benchmark material.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. No assertion-based reference tests found. No dependencies or reference executed. Browser/decision branches have specific unwired/faulty calls; owned stores are not shared standing-service capability.

filesystem.detail: Model-generated file blocks saved, plus host project reading; model path joins lack resolved containment guard.

processes.detail: Blocking space-split argv commands capture both pipes but drop stderr from repair/UI; no timeout/handles. Falsy success replays via decorator.

code_actions.detail: Generated application files and patcher branch plus arbitrary runner commands.

persistent_kernel.detail: No resident interpreter established in stage/Runner paths; subprocess per command.

standing_database.detail: Owned SQLite chat/state and exact-tag knowledge API; knowledge calls commented out, no model-facing query surface.

workflow_programming.detail: Python stage objects and fixed dispatch compose workflow; no model-authored hot program surface established.

multi_model.detail: Provider selector feeds same base model to every stage; no coordinated distinct participants.

live_collaboration.detail: Named stages are serial prompted roles, no live peer messaging established.

concurrent_work.detail: HTTP/socket threads overlap even active same-project work; no owned task/session arbitration.

steering_interrupt.detail: Question polls saved latest user message every five seconds; new input can launch another workflow. Inference timer does not cancel provider worker.

turn_redefinition.detail: Python fixed branches/templates are editable host code; no coordinated model hot turn activation.

compaction.detail: No managed conversation compaction established; stages construct independent prompts.

context_repair.detail: Persisted project chat and current file corpus can be rebuilt into follow-up prompt; no targeted archived-context repair.

original_audit.detail: Mutable JSON chat/state plus optional prompt logs; response content only and stderr discarded before capture; no complete original stream audit.

audit_query.detail: Host/operator project/chat/state reads expose snapshots, not comprehensive audit.

hot_change.detail: Config singleton changes immediately while captured stage models/import-time prompt templates persist; no turn/workflow boundary.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Saved application state is not handoff of active provider/process operations; no quiescent refit traced.

remote_services.detail: Provider adapters, first-link search/browser, deployment branch consume remote services.

self_improvement.detail: Failure prompts invoke application patcher; no governed harness-change experiment.

complaints.detail: No model complaint artifact with captured runtime state traced.

authority.detail: Main workflow executes commands/writes automatically; source joins model filenames and splits commands rather than supplying a coherent resource/authority contract.

evaluation.detail: Inspected benchmarks are not-yet marker; no assertion-based tests found in snapshot file inventory.

time_order.detail: Second-resolution wall timestamps, polling/sleeps and shared JSON replacements do not establish total order or cancellation.

evidence.claim: Socket input creates per-message Agent and starts threads even when prior work is active; no owner identity/cancellation.
Named stages all receive the same selected base model.
Initial workflow planner/monologue/research/question polling/search/coder/save/completion.
Follow-up action classifier selects answer/run/deploy/feature/bug/report with no generic tool loop.
Search results fetched through browser and formatter; standing knowledge read/write commented out.
File-block parser then host write using model filename joined into project path; no resolved containment guard.
UI vim commands emulate editing; actual file save is separate.
Commands split on spaces and synchronous subprocess.run without timeout; only stdout passed to state/repair. Retry counter shared across commands; function has no success return.
retry_wrapper repeats entire function on falsy result up to five attempts, including Runner.run_code returning None.
Inference executes selected provider in ThreadPoolExecutor; timeout raises/sys.exit but context manager waits for worker rather than cancellation.
Single user prompt returns message.content, excluding original response metadata.
Owned SQLite agent_state table stores JSON state stacks.
Stack additions rewrite stored JSON; latest-state updates replace entries.
Chat messages persisted as rewritten JSON stack; UI emitted before persistence.
Host queries latest user message and formatted project chat.
SQL knowledge table exact-tag add/get primitive; not wired to main search path.
Settings update mutates singleton and TOML immediately, no activation coordination.
Prompt templates captured at module import; per-stage clients capture model.
run-code endpoint returns started message despite TODO no execution.
Browser command grammar exists but LLM.inference call omits required project_name.
Decision branch git_clone is TODO; browser uses unassigned self.base_model; coding/pdf branches implemented.
Benchmark file contains only not-yet marker; no execution/oracle.

strengths: Explicit separation of application generation, search and repair stages makes workflow dataflow inspectable.
Stored chat/state supplies operator visibility, with concrete gaps against original audit.
limits: No assertion-based reference tests found. No dependencies or reference executed. Browser/decision branches have specific unwired/faulty calls; owned stores are not shared standing-service capability.
arconaut_questions: How should a workflow respond to steering while active without launching a second unowned execution?
Can every command result preserve stderr, exit status, identity and cancellation before model projection?
Which generated UI states are observations and which are theatrical emulation?
